intent: Independently audit the one additional completion-policy refinement before model execution.
reviewer: continuity_audit; did not author candidate recipe
verdict: clear for the focused development comparison; outcome and full acceptance unassessed

grounding.reason: Distinguishing demonstrated observation from completed point directly implements observation-before-behavior and evidence-based continuity. Earlier tutor progress or a covered label cannot substitute for this learner's demonstrated meaning. No constitutional priority or new exception is introduced.
grounding.disclosure: The existing separate component-attempt rule remains operative; this candidate does not weaken it.

checks.recipe_scope: Exactly four generic completion/progression substitutions and one appended learner-evidence repair rule, layered on unchanged sequence arm.
checks.application_method: Each exact replacement once, then two newlines and append text. Final executor transform must match or explain whitespace-only differences.

interpretation_limits: Existing phrases about a correct contribution, answered point and demonstrated idea plausibly compete with task-level progression; source inspection does not prove they caused the observed failures.
This arm changes generic completion policy in addition to labels and appended sequence, so its comparison is an additional refinement rather than evidence for labels alone.
The refinement was developed after examining current, labels and sequence failures; all cases remain exposed development evidence, not holdout validation.
Target behavior, judge protocol, case selection and thresholds must remain identical in the next freeze. Existing missingness and raw results remain preserved.

execution_freeze_review.verdict: V12 execution freeze verified; cleanup result and comparative acceptance still pending.
